title: Subspace character sum
statement: For a subspace $H$ of the $n$-dimensional binary cube and a point $x$ in that cube, define the subspace character sum at $x$ to be the sum, over all $\gamma\in H$, of the evaluation at $x$ of the character associated with $\gamma$.
hypotheses_covered: A subspace $H$ of the $n$-dimensional binary cube
A point $x$ in the $n$-dimensional binary cube
